name: AI SDR / Lead Research Agent
note: This is a sanitized workflow outline, not an importable automation-platform export. The original export was not published because it contains account, user, workflow, authentication, and Google Sheets identifiers. Re-export from the automation platform after reviewing/redacting identifiers and reconnect credentials before use.

steps.name: AI SDR / Lead Research Agent
steps.purpose: Accept the target company website URL as company_url.

steps.name: Company Research
steps.purpose: Build a structured company profile from public information; separate facts from observations.

steps.name: Company Analysis
steps.purpose: Identify business activities, possible operational problems, and potential AI/SaaS opportunities.

steps.name: Problem Identification
steps.purpose: Select a primary pain-point hypothesis and explain evidence and potential impact.

steps.name: Lead Qualification
steps.purpose: Score business relevance, problem relevance, potential business value, and AI/SaaS opportunity.

steps.name: Personalization
steps.purpose: Create a company-specific observation, value proposition, and low-friction call to action.

steps.name: Email Generator
steps.purpose: Draft a concise personalized email. Do not send it automatically.

steps.name: Google Sheets
steps.purpose: Store selected company research, qualification, draft, contact details, and review status. Reconfigure spreadsheet and credentials.

steps.name: Contact Research
steps.purpose: Find publicly listed business contact details; never guess email addresses and return null if unavailable.

safety_requirements: Do not invent company facts or present inferred pain points as confirmed facts.
Do not guess contact email addresses.
Configure provider credentials and Google Sheets connection in the automation platform.
Test all steps and mappings before enabling the workflow.
